mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish. Currently, we are seeing a light drizzle and 70 degrees at Verona Area High School. Expect an overnight low of 61 degrees with rain predicted. If you look up early tomorrow morning at 4:55 AM, you can spot the Space Station rising in the southwest over Mount Horeb and traveling high in the sky toward Fitchburg and Madison.

The City of Verona has provided updates on the Mark Drive reconstruction project, with Phase One nearly complete and Phase Two utility work underway. The city is also planning 2026 road rehabilitation projects on Gateway Pass and Enterprise Drive, and notes that its sidewalk policy ensures the city covers the full cost of new sidewalks with no special assessments to homeowners.

Local events are in full swing, including the Epic Systems User Group Meeting and trivia nights at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee all happening today. Tomorrow, you can visit the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, or plan ahead for the final Concert in the Park on Thursday, August 20th at Century School Park.

For our weekly police recap, on Thursday, August 13th, officers stopped and warned a 14-year-old boy for riding an eMoto electronic dirt bike on the roadway, and educated his father about the local prohibitions.
Tonight's flavor of the day at Culver's is the delicious Caramel Chocolate Pecan, and they are open until 10 PM. Tomorrow, you can look forward to Double Strawberry.
